limitations: Only accepted stable roots are logical references; other addresses remain fixed-block role observations.
Strategy, converter, recipient, gauge, and reward roles are governed or root-discovered and must not be frozen into another module.

roleResolution.rule: Savings evidence review candidate root; verify proxy code, slots, implementation and source at the operation block
read savings.strategy(); require strategy.vault()==savings and strategy.token()==MUSD
read savings.vaultGauge() and PoolsVoter.gauges(savings); require equality
read PCV.feeRecipient(); require it equals the active savings root before attributing MUSD revenue
read PCV.btcRecipient(), resolve proxy implementation, and require converter.musdSavingsRate()==savings
